import json,sys,pathlib,importlib.metadata,numpy as np
from kernel_envolve import load_best
from kernel_envolve.cli import evaluate,promote
from kernel_envolve.storage import evaluator_hash
import kernel_envolve
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
task=root/'task'
run,result=evaluate(task,mode='full')
assert result['execution']=='completed' and result['correctness']=='pass',result
assert result['decision']['eligible_for_best'],result
promote(run)
fn=load_best(task)
x=np.arange(19,dtype=np.float32);y=np.ones_like(x)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(fn(x,y),x+y)
report={'module_path':kernel_envolve.__file__,'version':kernel_envolve.__version__,'evaluator_hash':evaluator_hash(),'python':sys.version,'installed_distributions':sorted((d.metadata['Name'],d.version)for d in importlib.metadata.distributions()),'run_result':result,'promotion':'succeeded','public_entry':'verified'}
(root/'installed-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Installed module',kernel_envolve.__file__)
print('PASS',report['version'],report['evaluator_hash'],report['installed_distributions'])
